rows.meaning: Practical high-level source/package/service grouping with implementation ownership and replacement strategy.
A physical distribution or source grouping; packaging does not itself confer decision or state-write authority.
allowedAliases: distribution package when context is explicit

rows.meaning: A boundary around one model, vocabulary and reason to change.
allowedAliases: context when the owning boundary is already explicit

rows.meaning: The rule naming who may decide or write a specific truth, even when it crosses module boundaries.
A responsibility grouping used to reason about who owns an obligation; under A43 it is descriptive architecture vocabulary only.
rows.a43Guard: A ring never implies a new class or entity.

rows.meaning: Target-structure content awaiting the migration's independent review/cutover conditions; candidate status does not itself make it current authority.
The presently operative owner selected by the transitional switchboard/current-source mapping, not by path, recency or detail.
Historical evidence preserves what a source said and its provenance but has no current decision or runtime authority.
Producer emits a contract-shaped value or effect; every consumer is named and must interpret the same id/version, compatibility and failure rules.
rows.owner: the owning contract plus architecture contract registry
allowedAliases: caller / callee only for a direct in-process edge
writer / reader only for persisted data
prohibitedConflations: producer as state owner by default
single sampled consumer as all consumers

rows.meaning: A proposal records options or intended design without operative authority; a settled decision is recorded in the owning state/decision surface and may govern only its declared scope.
allowedAliases: decided outcome when scope is explicit
